speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are presenting with shortness of breath, increased abdominal girth, and a large ovarian mass. To determine the cause of these symptoms, have you experienced any recent weight loss or loss of appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: 40-year-old nulliparous woman. The patient reports experiencing shortness of breath and noticeable increase in abdominal size over the past month. She denies any significant medical history, previous surgeries, or use of medications.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Cancer with malignant ascites and pleural effusion. The combination of a large ovarian mass, rapid increase in abdominal girth (ascites), and shortness of breath in a 40-year-old woman is highly suggestive of advanced ovarian malignancy.
